notes: Official NVIDIA NeMo support for parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3 targets Linux environments.
Managed startup uses WSL by default on Windows. Install NeMo ASR and PyTorch in your WSL distribution first.
Set wslDistribution when you want a specific distro; leave linuxWorkdir/linuxScriptPath empty to auto-map Windows repo paths to /mnt/<drive>/...
